summary: Iteration 5 (admin footfall + Hindi AI + missing-doc hints) end-to-end verified. Backend: 11/11 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration5_admin_hindi_hints.py cover GET /api/admin/summary (200 for admin token with all totals+series keys and uploads==uploads_web+uploads_extension and len(series)==days; 422 for days=0/91; 403 'Not authorised' for non-admin; 401 without token), GET /api/auth/me is_admin true/false for the two seed sessions, POST /api/form-help+/api/chat with language='hi' produce Devanagari output while form-help question_options[].recommendation still quote the English option ('Male'/'Female'/'Transgender'); language='en' has no Devanagari, and POST /api/autofill/preview for [pan, vid, street, gn] returns suggested_documents ['PAN'] / ['VOTER_ID'] / ['VOTER_ID','UTILITY_BILL','DRIVING_LICENCE'] / 'Aarav Sharma' with AADHAAR correctly excluded, and summary.upload_hints sorted by field_count desc so VOTER_ID (field_count 2, labels 'Voter ID (if available)' + 'House No. and Street Name') is first. Regression: iteration_3 (17/17) + iteration_4 (15/15) tests still pass (43/43 total, /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration5.xml). Frontend: /admin behaves per spec — no cookie shows admin-denied 'Sign in required', non-admin cookie shows admin-denied 'Not authorised', admin cookie renders stat-signups/signins/uploads/autofills (with 'N web · M extension' subtext) + chart-uploads/autofills/signups/signins + stat-form-help + stat-chat; admin-range-7/-14/-30 update the 'Last N days' label. Profile menu (auth-user) contains profile-admin-link 'Footfall dashboard' for the admin (and navigates to /admin) and is ABSENT for the plain user. /demo Hindi: clicking input-given_name loads English advice-card; hitting lang-hi shows panel-loading and re-fetches advice in Devanagari with the labels 'विशेषज्ञ सलाह'/'महत्वपूर्ण'/'प्रश्न'. Chat tab: chat-input placeholder becomes 'फ़ॉर्म के बारे में पूछें...' and the Hindi user message yields a Devanagari chat-message-assistant reply. Missing-doc hints: /demo?tab=documents → review-autofill-btn shows upload-hints ('What to upload next') with upload-hint-VOTER_ID/UTILITY_BILL/DRIVING_LICENCE each 'Upload … to fill 1 more field (House No. & Street)'. Clicking input-street shows Field Help doc-hint-card with text 'Upload your Voter ID / Utility Bill / Driving Licence and FormWise can fill this for you.' and doc-hint-open-btn switches to Documents; clicking input-given_name (mapped) shows NO doc-hint-card. After review-apply-btn, autofill-result appears with compact upload-hints (2 entries max). Hindi hint text becomes 'अपना वोटर आईडी / यूटिलिटी बिल / ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस अपलोड करें और FormWise इसे आपके लिए भर सकता है।'. Mock page (/mock-passport.html) regression passes: click #givenName → #formwise-frame.visible → Field Help loads in English; lang-hi toggle re-fetches in Hindi (shim/background forwards language).
critical_code_review_comments: admin_router._count_by_day filters by ISO string >= since — safe because created_at/timestamp are always written as isoformat() UTC strings; if any future writer stores a datetime object the string comparison would silently mis-bucket. Consider a Pydantic-serialised timestamp helper.

admin summary route returns totals.users as a global count while all other totals are windowed by 'since' — reasonable but the field name may mislead admins into thinking 'users in this window'. Consider renaming to 'total_users' or documenting inline.

doc_services._suggest_documents preserves insertion order from form_requirements.documents; the test now asserts a specific order (['VOTER_ID','UTILITY_BILL','DRIVING_LICENCE']). This is fine as long as the requirements list ordering isn't accidentally reshuffled — worth a comment above the list.
doc_models.normalize_label uses word-boundary regex only for kw of length <=4, otherwise substring — 'pan' correctly requires \bpan\b so 'company' doesn't match, good. Verified behaviour end-to-end.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for all admin, Hindi and hint scenarios verified
